title: Serfs
content:
The [[Sanguine Lords]] and the [[lords of Thring]] keep serfs. Other parts of the world may as well. The serfs of [[Tarengael]] pray to the [[Green Lady]], but approach the [[Sorcerer of Tarengael Town]] for darker jobs.
